initial_failure_explanation: Parameter deepcopy omits existing .grad; corrected oracle explicitly captures original gradient identities and cloned values, rather than clearing gradients.
review_hash_explanation: Focused runner hashes UTF8 LF text before Windows CRLF write. Corrected independent review checks both normalized text hashes and raw file hashes; retained initial rejected review.
limits: Unit and saved-receipt controls are engineering validation, not further frozen model experiments or training benefit evidence.

limitations: Saved JSON and frozen source only; no model, optimizer, Torch, NumPy, suite or scientific replay executed.
Dense native parameter, gradient and update hashes plus m/v/t intervals recomputed from saved float32 values with stdlib.
Warmup gradients were not saved; warmup steps/state/parameters were checked for structure, consistency and source hash binding, not independently regenerated.
Compressed native tensor values were not saved; their three-policy interval receipts were checked structurally and bound to frozen source, not numerically regenerated.
Caller pointer/version/RNG preservation and clone storage disjointness are source-bound producer controls, not independent runtime measurements.
One tiny common-state diagnostic is not training quality, convergence, performance, memory saving, GPU or trajectory equivalence evidence.

saved_receipt_corruption_controls.note: First in-memory counter-control harness reserialized unchanged CRLF trajectory as LF, causing an extra integrity failure. Retained failure; corrected harness updates filehash without changing the saved product suite.
